documentTitle: Beyond The Vines | Returns Policy – Beyond The Vines Indonesia
title: Returns Policy

blocks.html:
If the items you've ordered are not working exactly right for you, we've got you covered.

You can return any items (some exceptions apply*) within 30 days of purchase in exchange for BTV Shopping Credits. You may return your items only once, and credits will be valid for a year from the date of issue! To be eligible for a return, items should be unwashed, with hangtags still securely fastened.

Exchanges are processed in the same way as returns.

Sale items and purchases made using selected discount codes are not eligible for returns or exchanges.

items.title: Start
items.html: Head to www.beyondthevines.co.id/a/service to start your returns journey

items.title: Submission
items.html: Once you’ve shared the relevant details with us, submit your returns request.

items.title: Review
items.html: Our Crew will take a couple of days to review your returns. You’ll receive a notification email once the returns request is approved.

items.title: Mail
items.html: Mail your items to The BTV Studio within 7 days. All return shipping charges are borne by the customer.

items.title: Credits
items.html: Once our Crew have checked your items and made sure everything is in place, we’ll credit you your BTV Shopping Credits.

blocks.html: *Exceptions: We are unable to process returns on sale items, bundles, sets, socks, eye masks, face masks, drinkware, stationery, and personalised products.

items: Label items with your order number and have them securely packed.
Mail it to us using registered postage to the address indicated in your return request approval within 7 days!

blocks.html: Should you require any additional assistance, contact us at customercare@beyondthevines.co.id
